title: Alibaba’s RISC-V IP powers over 6 billion shipped chips as tech giant targets AI, autos
text:
Alibaba Group Holding’s research arm, Damo Academy, has seen more than 6 billion chips shipped based on its XuanTie RISC-V architecture, marking a milestone as the tech giant doubles down on the open standard in artificial intelligence and automotive systems.
